I'm a hardware engineer, and on any given day I might be reading about magnetics, debugging an IC datasheet, tuning a microcontroller peripheral, or writing the software that ties it all together. For a long time the notes from that ended up scattered across notebooks and apps on different devices, half-findable at best.

This site is where those notes live now, split into three parts: a **Notebook** of topic write-ups with the math worked out, a set of browser-based **Tools** for the bench, and a **Calculators** section that pulls every calculator out of the notebook into one place for quick use without the derivation.

It's a running project: chapters, tools, and calculators get added as I work through new topics, and existing notes get revised as I learn more or find a cleaner way to derive something.
